title: EngagementListItem
description: One row of the per-firm engagement listing: at-a-glance indicator without opening the engagement (RF-030).
$comment: Source: DISENO 3.8.6 (view model EngagementListItem), S3 (e), S7 (e); engagement_state attributes; PRD RF-030, RF-033, RF-015. Internal attributes (PK/GSI keys, lastSeq, lastHookAt, version, audit) are never exposed. Audience: internal (S3, SX-01a) and public (S7). Residency: regional (cell of the firm).

templateId.description: Template id; null while UNCLASSIFIED and unknown.

currentVersion.description: Real base version label; null while UNCLASSIFIED.

classification.description: Classification (engagement_state.state without ARCHIVED; archived engagements are not listed, RF-010 'active' scope). UNCLASSIFIED must be rendered as 'verifying' (RF-015).

offer.description: Current offer, null when there is none.

updatedAt.description: Last update of the projection item (freshness, RF-037).
